description: Author-only fetch of a specific archived version of one of your reports, by positive-integer `version`. Returns metadata + the full payload (sections, citations, structured, markdown) — enough to render a diff against the current HEAD in the workspace editor. Use after `list_report_versions` identifies the version number you want; for the current HEAD use `get_report` instead. Any plan; only the report's author gets rows.

report_id.description: Identifier of the report whose archived version to fetch, as returned by create_report or list_my_reports.

name: get_report_version

_meta.description: Response metadata (provenance, point-in-time flag, freshness, request id and warnings). Every field is documented once in the agent contract (agent_contract.meta in the server's manifest.json).

title: Get Report Version
